hypothesis: Freeze a task-agnostic randomized-to-canonical SMILES translation autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, encode the ten fixed scored molecules as ten persistent latent particles, and optimize each objective by batch-synchronous Molecule Swarm Optimization: retain each particle's position, velocity, and personal-best memory, move it with inertia plus stochastic attraction toward its personal best and the current and historical swarm-best evaluated positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule de novo from every updated particle so oracle feedback directly steers later interacting trajectories without a surrogate.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. Oracle scores therefore steer interacting de novo latent trajectories directly, without fitting a surrogate or selecting from the corpus, and the 290 adaptive calls are concentrated on finding an exceptional terminal molecule for final Top-1.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supplies enough randomized and canonical SMILES pairs to train a frozen translation autoencoder whose latent codes reconstruct objective-session molecules and decode nearby particle positions with useful validity.

All fixed initial molecules can be encoded, and their latent dispersion and seeded initial velocities provide viable starting trajectories rather than placing the complete swarm outside decoder-supported space.

Oracle scores exhibit enough variation across current positions and particle histories to distinguish personal, current-swarm, and historical-swarm exemplars and thereby induce nontrivial cognitive or social motion.
High-scoring chemistry is reachable through continuous interacting trajectories in the learned latent representation rather than requiring a disconnected jump outside frozen decoder support.

Frozen decoding, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain enough per-particle yield for all ten identities to contribute one fresh proposal to every announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

The single globally communicating swarm can exploit useful shared directions within 29 adaptive rounds; the method may underperform on strongly multimodal objectives when attraction to an early global winner collapses latent and scaffold diversity, or when stochastic decoding weakens the association between a particle code and its returned score.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the frozen translation autoencoder cannot support valid de novo decoding, if emitted molecules cannot be traced to the updated latent state of a persistent particle, if accepted oracle scores do not deterministically update personal, current-swarm, and historical-swarm best memories before the next move, or if moves with distinct stored exemplars contain no reproducible oracle-dependent cognitive or social velocity contribution.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to build the SMILES vocabulary, randomized source views, canonical targets, and a compact sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder from the unlabeled corpus, verify held-out translation and valid decoding, and publish its configuration, latent statistics, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load and freeze the encoder and decoder on logical cuda:0, encode the fixed observations into one persistent particle per observation, initialize seeded velocities, and initialize current, personal, and historical best memories from their oracle scores. After each synchronized observe message, match every accepted score to its particle and exact proposal latent, update the three best-memory types by deterministic score rules, then advance every particle once with a recorded inertia term and independent stochastic cognitive, current-swarm, and historical-swarm attraction terms. Repeatedly sample the frozen decoder from each resulting particle code until that particle contributes one sanitized canonical molecule that is absent from the evaluated set, all prior emissions, and the current batch, and emit exactly the batch size announced by init; do not fit a surrogate, retrieve corpus molecules, screen a fixed pool, or update generator weights online.
research_intent.mechanism: Freeze a task-agnostic randomized-to-canonical SMILES translation autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, encode the ten fixed scored molecules as ten persistent latent particles, and optimize each objective by batch-synchronous Molecule Swarm Optimization: retain each particle's position, velocity, and personal-best memory, move it with inertia plus stochastic attraction toward its personal best and the current and historical swarm-best evaluated positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule de novo from every updated particle so oracle feedback directly steers later interacting trajectories without a surrogate.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, giving this batch-size-10 optimizer just 29 synchronized feedback rounds in which to turn sparse scores into coordinated de novo search; unproductive latent motion, premature convergence to one decoded basin, or invalid and duplicate decodes can consume those rounds without finding an exceptional terminal molecule.

applicability_conditions: Corpus preparation is now supported across three independently seeded artifacts with 238,944-239,018 training pairs and held-out valid canonical decode rates from 0.4296875 to 0.465625. Transfer requires comparable randomized/canonical corpus support; exact target reconstruction is too weak to claim faithful molecular identity preservation.

The fixed initial panel is supported across all 15 task sessions: all ten molecules encode with zero out-of-vocabulary tokens, initialize ordered persistent identities p000-p009 and ten distinct scaffolds, and begin with mean pairwise latent distance from 4.7411553288847905 to 5.017109382586896.

Feedback-driven memory and motion are supported when score batches distinguish exemplars: all 435 accepted batches contain 8-10 distinct scores, all 4,350 feedback rows match exactly, 645 personal-best and 64 historical-best replacements occur, and all 4,271 moves with distinct stored exemplars receive positive nonzero oracle-dependent pressure.

Continuous frozen-latent reachability is supported on the five Hard-Five objectives under Search Seeds 0, 1, and 2: every one of the 15 task summaries ends above its fixed initial Top-1. This does not establish reachability for disconnected rewarding regions or chemistry absent from the prepared translator.

Operational decoding is supported under batch size 10 and the observed retry margin: all 435 rounds emit exactly ten task-locally novel valid molecules, pooled yield is 0.26737967914438504, and the hardest particle requires 46 attempts versus the 1,200-attempt bound, with no evaluator-level invalid or duplicate proposal.

One globally communicating ten-particle swarm is supported for 29 adaptive rounds, but the all-seed terminal mean pairwise distance averages 0.8738137765978845 versus 4.901414280094062 at initialization. Multiple decoded chemotypes persist, yet applicability to strongly multimodal objectives remains uncertain because latent collapse is substantial and stochastic decode weakens particle-to-score locality.

The confirmed activation result covers the frozen 300-call, batch-10 profile and Search Seeds 0, 1, and 2 with fresh task-local state. It does not establish behavior under another oracle budget, batch size, corpus, particle count, online generator update, or cross-task state sharing.

possible_failure_causes: Canonical-target reconstruction remains very weak despite usable molecular validity: the two new preparations reconstruct only 1/320 zero-noise targets each, and the all-seed rate is 4/960. The evidence supports a decoder-valid local code space, not a faithful identity-preserving translation manifold; stochastic decoding can therefore weaken the link between a scored molecule and the latent particle position credited for it.

Frozen-decoder efficiency varies materially across independent preparations. Seed 2's pooled yield is 0.2220860775003829 versus 0.2985996705107084 on seed 1 and 0.2968877968877969 on seed 0, and the all-seed audit contains 11,876 sanitization failures plus one non-completion. The observed 46-attempt maximum remains far below the 1,200 cap, but weaker corpus support or more difficult latent regions could consume the retry allowance.

Global-best communication reproducibly collapses latent diversity: every terminal session has mean pairwise distance at most 1.3203108013035534 from an initialization of at least 4.7411553288847905. Although all batches retain ten molecules and 8-10 scaffolds, scaffold counts alone may conceal convergence within one reward basin, so strongly multimodal objectives remain a plausible premature-convergence failure mode.

Velocity clipping is active rather than negligible: 8,300 velocity coordinates and 191 position coordinates clip across the three seeds. The realized projection remains positive and all formulas reproduce exactly, but harder objectives or larger exemplar separations could make the bounded dynamics follow clipped rather than proportional PSO directions more often.

Preparation is stochastic: the three seeds produce different frozen artifact hashes, vocabulary sizes, initial latent geometry, and held-out validity rates. Activation survives the observed range, but transfer is less secure for a preparation with substantially worse nonzero-noise validity, out-of-vocabulary initial molecules, or a fixed panel encoded outside decoder-supported space.

These replicas establish execution, feedback dependence, latent dynamics, and operational yield; they do not isolate the separate terminal-score contributions of corpus translation training, cognitive attraction, current-swarm attraction, historical-swarm attraction, clipping, or stochastic decoding.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supplies enough randomized and canonical SMILES pairs to train a frozen translation autoencoder whose latent codes reconstruct objective-session molecules and decode nearby particle positions with useful validity.

All fixed initial molecules can be encoded, and their latent dispersion and seeded initial velocities provide viable starting trajectories rather than placing the complete swarm outside decoder-supported space.

Oracle scores exhibit enough variation across current positions and particle histories to distinguish personal, current-swarm, and historical-swarm exemplars and thereby induce nontrivial cognitive or social motion.
High-scoring chemistry is reachable through continuous interacting trajectories in the learned latent representation rather than requiring a disconnected jump outside frozen decoder support.

Frozen decoding, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain enough per-particle yield for all ten identities to contribute one fresh proposal to every announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

The single globally communicating swarm can exploit useful shared directions within 29 adaptive rounds; the method may underperform on strongly multimodal objectives when attraction to an early global winner collapses latent and scaffold diversity, or when stochastic decoding weakens the association between a particle code and its returned score.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if the frozen translation autoencoder cannot support valid de novo decoding, if emitted molecules cannot be traced to the updated latent state of a persistent particle, if accepted oracle scores do not deterministically update personal, current-swarm, and historical-swarm best memories before the next move, or if moves with distinct stored exemplars contain no reproducible oracle-dependent cognitive or social velocity contribution.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to build the SMILES vocabulary, randomized source views, canonical targets, and a compact sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder from the unlabeled corpus, verify held-out translation and valid decoding, and publish its configuration, latent statistics, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load and freeze the encoder and decoder on logical cuda:0, encode the fixed observations into one persistent particle per observation, initialize seeded velocities, and initialize current, personal, and historical best memories from their oracle scores. After each synchronized observe message, match every accepted score to its particle and exact proposal latent, update the three best-memory types by deterministic score rules, then advance every particle once with a recorded inertia term and independent stochastic cognitive, current-swarm, and historical-swarm attraction terms. Repeatedly sample the frozen decoder from each resulting particle code until that particle contributes one sanitized canonical molecule that is absent from the evaluated set, all prior emissions, and the current batch, and emit exactly the batch size announced by init; do not fit a surrogate, retrieve corpus molecules, screen a fixed pool, or update generator weights online.
research_intent.mechanism: Freeze a task-agnostic randomized-to-canonical SMILES translation autoencoder trained only on the unlabeled corpus, encode the ten fixed scored molecules as ten persistent latent particles, and optimize each objective by batch-synchronous Molecule Swarm Optimization: retain each particle's position, velocity, and personal-best memory, move it with inertia plus stochastic attraction toward its personal best and the current and historical swarm-best evaluated positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule de novo from every updated particle so oracle feedback directly steers later interacting trajectories without a surrogate.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, giving this batch-size-10 optimizer just 29 synchronized feedback rounds in which to turn sparse scores into coordinated de novo search; unproductive latent motion, premature convergence to one decoded basin, or invalid and duplicate decodes can consume those rounds without finding an exceptional terminal molecule.
